project.name: Gully Legends Prague
project.purpose: Gaming/comic styled cricket website, Supabase-backed cricket match management, player progression, Hall of Legends rankings, Monthly Beasts awards, Formula Room documentation, and shared Gallery for the Gully Legends Prague cricket group.
project.styling: Tailwind CSS plus custom CSS in app/globals.css
project.primaryDataSource: Supabase when NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE is unset or set to supabase
project.localFallbackMode: NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE=local preserves local browser fallback behavior for development
project.databaseStatus: Supabase Auth, Postgres, RLS, RPC finalisation, Monthly Beast writes, Demo Reset, and Gallery Storage persistence are implemented.
project.phaseStatus: Current project is stable on main: 21-player roster, approved responsive dashboard, Supabase-backed public reads, Admin-only writes, Quick Scoring, atomic match finalisation, reset-safe player progression, Monthly Beasts Crown/Reopen, Demo Reset, demo test match helper, Supabase Gallery persistence, private server-side Team Balance / Shuffle, and illustrated match scoring documentation are implemented.

commands.windowsNote: Use npm.cmd in PowerShell because npm.ps1 may be blocked by execution policy.

securityNotes: Use the Supabase publishable key only.
Do not put service-role credentials in .env.local or browser-facing code.
Admin authorization is enforced by Supabase Auth plus public.is_admin().

mustDo: Keep navigation and buttons as genuine clickable elements.
Use next/image for approved raster assets when rendered in React unless the existing component intentionally uses img, such as Gallery.
Keep text readable on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Keep the visual style funky, comic, cricket/gaming themed.
mustNotDo: Do not use a full-page screenshot with invisible clickable hotspots.
Do not redesign approved assets or regenerate backgrounds unless explicitly asked.
Do not modify supplied artwork assets unless explicitly requested.
Do not expose private team-balancing weights in UI, public player data, API responses, labels, tooltips, logs, or accessibility text.
Do not add demo toggles to normal public/Admin Create Match forms.
Do not modify Supabase data manually unless the user explicitly asks.
doNotChangeWithoutExplicitRequest: XP, Level, Player Power, and match-result formulas

rules: Do not regenerate, repaint, blur heavily, recolor, replace, or modify it.
Important baked-in signs and wall text must remain visible.
Current hero uses full-width image rendering inside an overflow-hidden wrapper with limited top-sky crop only.
The emblem includes the Gully Legends title and No Rules. Only Fun! tagline.
Do not render a duplicate HTML tagline.
Do not increase navbar height to enlarge the logo.
Do not crop, resize source files, recolor, regenerate, or replace them.
Render complete cards with object-fit: contain where full-card presentation is required.
The title is embedded in the PNG; do not render player.cardTitle as visible duplicate title on cards or detail pages.

usage: Stats / Formula Room - Player Power tab

players.rule: Add players only to the canonical roster and let all player-driven features consume that roster.
currentDisplayNotes: Stable ID jogindar currently displays as Jogi.

players.resetStateRule: After Reset Demo Data or a clean zero-career state, Blade Power, Delivery Threat, and Field Reflex must all show 0/100.

supabase.publicReads: Implemented through Supabase anonymous read repositories and RLS.
supabase.adminWrites: Implemented through authenticated Admin APIs, RLS, and security-definer RPCs.
supabase.storage: Gallery uses existing public Supabase Storage bucket named gallery.
securityRules: public.is_admin() uses SECURITY DEFINER and set search_path = ''.
Fresh match finalisation requires database match status in_progress.
Finalisation, Monthly Beast Crown/Reopen, and Demo Reset use advisory locks to avoid unsafe races.
Normal public visitors cannot upload/edit/delete Gallery photos or modify cricket data.
Do not use service-role credentials in application code.

matchWorkflow.status: Supabase-backed in normal mode with local fallback available.
features: Manual team selection with cross-team mutual exclusion
Draft saving without complete scorecard data
Dismissal details only for wickets that occurred
Scheduled fixture delete before play starts
Quick Scoring with single-batter and two-batter modes
Mobile-friendly scoring controls, innings breaks, and Undo Last Ball
Cancel and Restart from active scoring

teamBalancing.status: Implemented as a server-only automatic balancing helper.
teamBalancing.clientContract: Client sends availablePlayerIds and sharedPlayerId; API returns teamAPlayerIds and teamBPlayerIds or a generic error.
teamBalancing.privacyRule: Do not expose private balancing weights, groups, totals, or separation reasons in UI text, public API responses, accessibility labels, player profiles, logs, README, or public-facing docs.
teamBalancing.algorithm: Small candidate partition search. Shared Player is removed from exclusive candidate pool, valid team sizes are generated, private server-side constraints are applied, candidates are scored lexicographically, and a random equally optimal candidate is returned.
scoringPriority: Then remaining private weight-group composition differences in order
teamBalancing.manualOverride: Manual team assignment, Shared Player selection, Update Players, and Cancel & Restart editing remain unrestricted by private automatic balancing preferences.
teamBalancing.fieldingHelpers: Fielding Helper status has zero effect on automatic team strength.

resultRules: First-batting team wins by first innings runs minus chasing innings runs.
Chasing team wins by wickets remaining: chasing team player count minus chasing wickets lost.
Equal final totals mean a tie.
No Result is only for abandoned or cancelled matches.

demoTestHelper.buttonLocation: Admin Control Room Demo Data section
demoTestHelper.rule: Server creates temporary demo draft with is_demo=true; normal Create Match remains is_demo=false and has no demo checkbox.

progressionSystem.levelProtection: Achieved level cannot decrease; penalties cannot drop XP below the current level threshold.

playerPower.bladePower: Batting performance; zero innings batted returns 0 rather than percentile fallback 50.
playerPower.deliveryThreat: Bowling performance; no bowling data returns 0.
playerPower.display: Player cards and player detail both use player.ratings as the single source.

hallOfLegends.purpose: Who is leading and where everyone ranks.

formulaRoom.purpose: How XP, Levels, Player Power, and cricket results are calculated.
formulaRoom.rule: Do not maintain separate display formulas and calculation formulas.

leaderboardAndFormulaRoom.monthlyBeastsDistinction: Hall of Legends current month uses raw statistical leaders; Monthly Beasts use overall discipline XP awards.

gallery.status: Supabase-backed in Supabase mode; IndexedDB preserved for local fallback mode.
gallery.publicUrlRule: Use Supabase Storage getPublicUrl; do not use signed URLs for public Gallery images.
uploadRules: Do not upload immediately on selection; preserve preview/review first.
Upload directly to Supabase Storage with authenticated Admin JWT.
If metadata insert fails, attempt Storage cleanup.
Normal real Gallery uploads use is_demo=false.
deleteRules: Do not delete directly from storage.objects.
Restore deleted_at if Storage removal fails.
publicRules: Logged-out visitors can browse Gallery metadata/images and lightbox.
Logged-out visitors cannot upload, edit, delete, or feature photos.

coverageThemes: Private server-side Team Balance / Shuffle behavior
Quick Scoring delivery events, innings breaks, undo, and mobile source checks
Advanced cricket stats and Duck Collector logic
Hall of Legends and Monthly Beasts distinction
Supabase Gallery persistence and local fallback
tests.generatedArtifact: .test-build is generated by npm run test and should not be committed.

lastVerified.result: All passed after the stable Team Balance / Shuffle metadata update.

beforeVisualChanges: Inspect design-reference/gully-legends-dashboard.png and exact approved assets relevant to the request.
Do not make generic redesigns when the user asks for targeted changes.
beforeSupabaseChanges: Inspect existing migrations and RLS assumptions.
Do not execute SQL remotely unless explicitly instructed.
Do not weaken public.is_admin(), RLS, or SECURITY DEFINER search_path hardening.
beforeMatchWorkflowChanges: Inspect lib/types/match.ts, lib/match-records.ts, lib/progression.ts, components/matches/MockMatchEntryForm.tsx, and Supabase match repositories.
Preserve the existing atomic finalisation path.
filesystemSafety: Do not reset or revert user changes.
Do not delete or modify approved image assets unless explicitly requested.
